notes.title: Update v1.0.2.4300
notes.content:
22.09.2018
v1.0.2.4252
Fixed. (System) of the functioning of the modules
Fixed. (System) menu spaceport continued to work, even if the spaceport was not selected
Optimized. Background graphic background
Added. Full screen loading window

25.10.2018
v1.0.2.4300
Fixed. Incorrect sound settings
Changed. Icon for attaching station modules
Added. The game automatically adapts to the resolution of your screen.
Fixed. After creating a new game, the FPS fell heavily due to the large number of objects generated
Changed. When creating a new game, you do not need to include modules, now all modules work independently
Fixed. The console has been locked for input. Key[~]

Attention, the following commands can be used in the game console without quotes and brackets
To bring up the game console, press the tilde [~] key

[del bq] - deletes all background images on the map (will give a big performance boost)
[many resource] - gives 999999 resources

[map disable] - disables the mini card (may give a small performance boost)
[map enable] - enable mini-map

Responsible for the work of the system module ration modules
[disable mod food] - disable work function
[enable mod food] - enable work function

Responsible for the operation of the system module oxygen
[disable mod oxygen] - disable work function
[enable mod oxygen] - enable work function

Responsible for the operation of the systems and control of the lead ship (cruiser)
[disable mod hero] -  disable work function
[enable mod hero] - enable work function

Responsible for building modules by points
[disable mod point build] -  disable work function
[disable mod point build] -  enable work function

notes.title: Update v1.0.2.4137
notes.content:
Fixed. The modules began to be built again and again.
Fixed. The brightness of the modules during construction was too dark and poorly visible, now they are brighter by 40 %.
Fixed. During the construction of the modules, it was possible simultaneously to control the menu of the factories and greenhouses.
Fixed. System: Point-to-Point - constantly created without the reason of module positioning point.
Fixed. The enemies self-destructed for no reason during the battle.
Fixed. Artificial intelligence ship "Vencor" reported no damage to the ship.

Fixed. There is no more circle for modules! Now they are highlighted.
Fixed. The construction of modules no longer requires engineers, scientists and biologists, now the main resources are metals(titanium and steel).
Changed. Module building system-no longer need to scroll through the invisible list of modules by pressing Q and E, you can now select any module in the list with the mouse.

Added. New interface, all buttons with modules are placed in the bottom panel of the screen. Everything is done so that you can see all the buttons with modules.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32824878/a42c0d41915d4f60f3e6fa958b67f0ae981afcb6.jpg

Added. Strips with information about the strength of the modules is no more. To see the amount of strength of the modules, you need to hover the mouse over the module.
Added. Over the progress of building modules, its value appears in seconds.
Added. The module building menu is divided into categories: factories, turrets, science, army, electricity, food, support and parts of the modules.
Added. In the sound settings - volume control of speech.

Remove. Part of the old interface.
Remove. Game guide (in the next update there will be a new, detailed training section)

Localization
Added. The English voice acting(some of the phrases on the final event).

Optimization of the systems of the game.

Please email us about the sound in the game. What phrases would You like to hear in the game in Your language?

If you want to participate in the scoring of the game in your language, please email us contact@artepi.com mmm .
Don't forget to attach the test audio file or files in any of the formats: wav, mp3, flac, ogg, etc.

Test phrases of acting:
You can voice in your own language with a translation into your own language.
English, Russian, French, Spanish, etc.
"Required minerals", "Insufficient metal", "Research completed" etc ...

You can help us to localize the text of the game into Your language, send us an email with the subject (Text localization)

We will select the best candidates to continue to be able to cooperate with you.

(you can help us in localizing the game - text, voice. Contact us on Discord or mail.)

Removed. 4 skins module connecting the bridge

Removed. Animation of destructibility of modules, in the future, we can return this function. (loads the CPU).

(The main systems work in full.) All modules in the game are disabled, before processing !!!)

Optimized.  New skins of modules, occupy 200 MB of RAM less.
Optimized.  The game files became less weighty, which leads to the least time spent on the files on the hard disk.

The note. The game can be very slow on disks, which have a slow reading speed. Usually - these discs live in laptops. We recommend using SSD.

In the next update will be affected the main game interface, storage system, etc.

Many people ask about the story, (what happened in the game, why is there a station and 3 ships?)

On the picture below, you can see the location of the hint button. You need to left-click on it to display the block of hints.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32824878/17a48974ea09d637aa6803cb157123223889d897.jpg

Localization

Message from the developer: 
The main functions of the game work stably. You can start a battle, get resources, build your station from scratch, manage your ships (Venkor and Admiral), buy a turret for the ship (Admiral) and even control the turrets.

Added. New interface, with minimal system load. A new interface, touched upon (main game interaction panel, spaceport panel, panel when the buildings is switched on).

Added. The required cost of resources in the construction of buildings, changes color, if there are enough resources for construction, then in green, if not enough resources, then in red.

Changes. The right mouse button will not close the construction window. To close the construction window, use the orange button with the arrow (back).
Changes.  Buildings no longer receive random numbers (health) at startup, now they have a fixed value.
Changes. The brightness of the buttons is increased in the factory menu, after activation.
Changes.  The "fast battle" module is temporarily disabled.


* Localization of the game interface in English, will appear in the next update!


Critical change.  When you turn on the "enemy attack" mode, enemy ships are now created in small groups with a certain periodicity. However, each time enemies will stay faster, and time will decrease, and their number will grow.
This change will allow to play without heavy load on the processor.

If your computer slows down, when the enemy appears, then try turning off the Mini-map, this will bring about 4% of the performance.
You need to open the console by pressing the [~] key and enter a sentence "map disable" without quotes and to include back "map enable". 
We are still working on optimization ...


Message from the developer: 
We read your feedback and take into account your wishes. We are aware of many mistakes and some flaws in the game.

Please read the "early access" section carefully. 

We constantly develop new features and fix bugs in the game.
We will release updates as often as possible. We draw attention to the fact that at this stage of the development of the game, the main task of the game is the construction of a base.

Attention: the game is very demanding on RAM, the higher and higher its frequency the better. For a stable game, we recommend at least 8 GB of memory.


Your feedback is very important to us.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.3290
notes.content:
Fixed  - When you open the store menu, the ship "Admiral" could be selected.
 Fixed  - When the "Fast battle" module was turned on, at the beginning of the game the mini map was not correctly displayed and it was possible to allocate buildings.


 Localization 
 Added  - partial localization of the text in English (game menu, admiral's interface, store interface).

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.3285
notes.content:
Fixed  - Ships "Admiral" and "Wencor" can now be selected and operated by the mouse.
 Fixed  - In the main game menu, the "Campaign" button was not darkened (there is no company in the game).
 Fixed  - When entering the store menu, the "Admiral" and "Wencor" pictogram control buttons continued to be displayed.
 Fixed  - In the mode of control of the ship "Admiral", when switching the control of the turrets (rotation and fire) - The control mode of the AI ​​did not work.


 Added  - Interface of life indicators of the Admiral's box, - appears after the "Admiral" control is turned on.
 Added  - Now the "Admiral" has a cargo hold.
 Added  - "Wencor" can download resources to the ship "Admiral", if you fly to him on "Wencor" for this you need to click on the ship "Admiral".
